# `regexp_count`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a count of the number of times that the regular expression pattern `regexp` is matched in the string `str`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
regexp_count(str, regexp)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- regexp_count, example 1
> SELECT regexp_count('Steven Jones and Stephen Smith are the best players', 'Ste(v|ph)en');
2
```

```sql
-- regexp_count, example 2
> SELECT regexp_count('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', '[a-z]{3}');
8
```
